source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Retypes 81 reward rules whose own text states an absolute points count (N points per Rs.M) but which were stored as multiplier, the field the app computes as rate x base rate x point value. 15 rendered a wrong number; the other 66 were right only because those cards happen to earn exactly 1 point per the same unit, which made both readings agree - they were one base-rate edit away from breaking silently. Same mechanism as the 24% IndianOil fuel rate. Every value comes from the rule's own sentence; nothing researched.
